source.title: Volume Weighted Average Price Optimal Execution

claims.statement: Child volumes sum to the parent order and have the same sign.
For the constant-spread static case, each child volume is parent volume times its expected market-volume share.

adaptations: A declared four-interval illustrative profile substitutes for an estimated intraday NYSE volume distribution.
The reference engine submits market children on synthetic one-minute bars and fills on the next open.
